This new Exotic arrives with the Echoes of Central Park DLC, but getting your hands on it requires more than simply completing the campaign. You'll need to survive the park's dangerous endgame activities and take down some formidable enemies.

How to get the Ratel exotic AR in Echoes of Central Park, and everything about the Guardians: how to spawn all 6, how to beat every single one, the build that kills them in seconds, and the new Apex Protocol gear set.

Quick reference:
• 6 Guardians: the Howl Pulse boss ends the Central Park main mission (and unlocks the game mode). The other 5 live in the Central Park mode: Corrosive Trap, Leech Hive, Blackout Seeker, Trophy System and Gas Bomber.
• Spawn: find the lair in a zone, kill NPCs until the meter on your shoulder is full, wound the Guardian, reach the lair before the timer runs out, clear the NPCs there and he spawns. Kill him and you unlock his skill.
• Every Guardian has the same weakness: destroy his skill, then burst him in the damage window.
• Build: Prima Donna + 4 Aces & Eights + Iron Will + Melon Baller. Normal gear works, your prototype gear is normalized in Central Park.
• Kill all 5 and Contaminated unlocks. Your first full clear in Contaminated gives the Ratel guaranteed, after that it's a chance per run.
• Every finished run: 8 exotic components + 3 exotic caches. My runs took about 15–20 minutes.
• Ratel (Voracious): more amplified damage the more armor and health the enemy has lost, 1 stack per 100 weapon hits, max 4.

The NEW Ratel Exotic Assault Rifle has arrived in The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park, and this weapon is definitely something different!

In today’s video, we’re taking a closer look at the Ratel, exploring its unique Exotic talent, Voracious, and understanding how this unusual weapon is intended to function. This isn’t your typical run-and-gun Exotic, and getting the most out of it requires a different approach.

So, how does Voracious work?

* Every 100 weapon hits grants 1 stack.
* You can build up to 4 stacks.
* Each stack provides +20% maximum amplified damage and +15% reload speed.
* At maximum stacks, that’s up to 80% maximum amplified damage and 60% reload speed.
* The damage amplification scales with the amount of armor and health an enemy has lost.
* Stacks begin to decay after 3 seconds without shooting or reloading.

Ratel Exotic Weapon Stats & Mods:

* Optic: +15% Critical Hit Chance.
* Magazine: +20 Rounds.
* Underbarrel: +10% Weapon Handling.
* Third attribute: Randomized, with Damage to Targets Out of Cover being an interesting option.

The Ratel shares its base weapon stats with the high-end Honey Badger, but its Exotic talent and weapon modifications give it a completely different identity.

We’ll also explore how to maintain its stacks, understand its damage potential, and approach combat encounters in a way that makes the most of this weapon.

Echoes of Central Park DLC

The newest DLC takes Agents into the Upper West Side and Central Park in New York, introducing a darker, horror-inspired experience with a new campaign, three companions, six new skill variants, a new gear set, and the Ratel Exotic.

There’s plenty of new content to explore, and this is just one of the new additions worth taking a closer look at.

If you’re still trying to understand this Exotic or wondering how to get the most out of its unusual talent, hopefully this video gives you a better understanding of what makes the Ratel so interesting.

Thanks for watching, Agents!

I tested the new Apex Protocol gear set on stream, and two things in it don't work the way the tooltip says. The bonus stacks can't be refreshed, so they're gone when the 30 seconds run out. And with two Guardian skills equipped, the base stacks don't decay at all, which actually helps you. Here's how the set works, what's bugged, what works (the chest's Veer Override amp), and why I'm stashing it until the refresh is fixed.

Quick reference:
• 2-piece: +10% weapon damage, +10% skill damage. 3-piece: +15% weapon handling, +15% hazard protection.
• Apex Engine (4-piece): weapon hits build base stacks. At 100 they're consumed for one bonus stack: +1 skill tier, +65% weapon damage for 30 s, and -10 s on active skill cooldowns. Max 3 bonus stacks, so on paper that's +3 skill tiers and +195% weapon damage.
• Base stack decay: the tooltip says 10 stacks every 5 s, and 5 less with two Guardian skills. In my test, two Guardian skills means no decay at all.
• Bug 1 (helps you): with two Guardian skills, base stacks don't decay.
• Bug 2 (hurts you): bonus stacks don't refresh. Three bonus stacks vanish when the timer runs out.
• Chest Veer Override (needs Apex Engine): at max stacks, enemies hit by your skills are marked for 10 s, and marked enemies take +20% amplified damage. The +20% works in my test. Not every enemy got marked in real content.
• Backpack Veer Failsafe (needs Apex Engine): +5% armor on kill and +10% skill damage per bonus stack.
• Guardian skills come from the Guardians in Central Park. How to get every one: [LÄNK GUARDIANS-GUIDEN]

Full build video when the refresh is fixed. Until then: stash it.
